benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: Kotak Cashback+ Credit Card is a core cashback-focused card designed to reward everyday spends such as online grocery, food delivery, online entertainment and fuel expenses. Beyond accelerated spends, cardholders earn 0.5% unlimited cashback across all other eligible categories. While the card covers multiple everyday spends, low monthly cashback capping limits the overall saving potential, especially for high spenders. Read on to know about this card’s features and benefits along with a view on who should get this card.

3% cashback on fuel spends across all petrol pumps regardless of brand
milestone_benefits: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between Rs. 500 and Rs. 4,000. Maximum waiver of Rs. 3,500 can be availed in a year
Annual fee waived off on spending Rs. 2 Lakh or more in the preceding year

insurance_cover: Covers more ground in entertainment with benefits on OTT subscriptions and gaming
get_this_card_if: You are looking to save on everyday expenses like groceries and food delivery
You spend a significant amount on movies and entertainment (including OTT)
You do not have a fuel credit card and would like to save on your fuel spends
You do not need benefits on other categories or additional perks like lounge access, etc.

faqs.q: How can I claim the cashback accumulated on my card?
faqs.a: To claim cashback on your card, you need to redeem the accumulated reward points. For this, you can visit the Kotak Rewards Platform, login using your customer ID and password and proceed to redeem. The cashback will be credited to your card account.

faqs.q: What is the maximum cashback I can earn on non-accelerated categories?
faqs.a: There is no limit on the base cashback earning.

faqs.q: What happens to the earned cashback if I cancel a transaction?
faqs.a: When you cancel a transaction or return a purchase, cashback earned on such transactions will be reversed.

faqs.q: If I make a purchase on EMI, how much cashback will I earn?
faqs.a: EMI transactions are not eligible to earn cashback. If the cashback is credited before the conversion of transaction into EMIs, the earned cashback will be reversed.

faqs.q: What is Kotak Mahindra Bank’s credit card customer care number?
faqs.a: You can reach Kotak Credit Card customer care on 1860 266 2666.

faqs.question: Is the Kotak Cashback+ Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: The card currently comes with a limited-time zero joining fee offer. However, the annual fee of ₹750 + GST is still applicable from the second year onwards.

faqs.question: What is the cashback cap on the Kotak Cashback+ Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The combined cashback on 5% and 3% accelerated categories is capped at 750 reward points per billing cycle.

faqs.question: Does the Kotak Cashback+ Credit Card offer cashback on fuel?
faqs.answer: Yes, the card offers 3% cashback on eligible fuel transactions.

faqs.question: Does the Kotak Cashback+ Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: No, the Kotak Cashback+ Credit Card does not provide airport lounge access benefits.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup fee on the Kotak Cashback+ Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The forex markup fee is approximately 3.5% + GST, making the card less suitable for international spending.
